nodes.label: Deny-by-default Firestore & Storage Rules
nodes.rationale: Deny-by-default; public visitors may only read site content and create applications/orders. Publishing rules before creating the admin user locks the dashboard out, so SECURITY.md must be followed in order.

nodes.label: Tasks Internal Work Backbone
nodes.rationale: Tasks are independent of any customer/service so all internal work lives in one place; completing a priced task auto-creates a pending invoice and mirrors completion into linked service milestones, removing the need to jump to Service Mgmt just to check something off.

nodes.label: Customer Service Milestones
nodes.rationale: milestones[] entries carry taskId for sync with the Tasks tab but can still be added directly in the Service Mgmt edit modal without a taskId, for backwards-compatible fine-grained editing.

nodes.label: Discovery Questionnaire Flow
nodes.rationale: Link requires no customer login so prospects without accounts can answer: firestore.rules allows a public get by direct doc id (not list) and a one-time update restricted to answers/status/completedAt, blocked once status is 'completed'. Answers autosave to browser localStorage in case the tab is closed.

nodes.label: Rule-Based Questionnaire Analyzer
nodes.source_location: Key User Flows > discovery questionnaire step 7
nodes.rationale: No backend/AI in this stack, so analysis is keyword rules matched on question wording + answer text, which works on both template and custom questionnaires. Produces an Internal Report (scored service tiers, evidence, investment estimate) and a Client-Facing view without scores/prices.

nodes.label: Industry WhatsApp Routing
nodes.rationale: Per-industry phone mapping routes each application's quiz report to whichever team member or group handles that sector.

nodes.label: Application Approval Flow
nodes.source_location: Key User Flows > New partner applies
nodes.rationale: Customer auth account is created on a secondary Firebase app instance so the admin stays signed in. Approving does NOT assign any service or create anything billable - quiz answers are only a signal of what to sell.

nodes.label: Security Setup Guide
nodes.rationale: Closes the hole where anyone on the internet could read/write every collection, including the plaintext admin password in settings/access.

nodes.label: Admin Login via Firebase Authentication
nodes.rationale: Rules can only tell an admin apart from a random visitor if the admin has a real Firebase Auth identity, so admin login moved from a Firestore-stored password to Firebase Auth email+password backed by an admins/{uid} registry doc.

nodes.label: Ordered Rollout Steps
nodes.rationale: Publishing the rules before creating the admin account locks you out of the admin dashboard (data stays safe, but the remaining steps must be finished to get back in) - hence create admin user, register admins/{uid}, deploy site, THEN publish rules.

nodes.label: Validated Public Create on applications/orders
nodes.rationale: Public create is validated (required fields, field allow-list, size caps) but not rate-limited; if spam becomes a problem, add Firebase App Check or a Cloud Function with reCAPTCHA. The web API key in firebase-config.js is safe to expose because access control is enforced server-side by the rules.

nodes.label: Website Creation

nodes.label: 15-Month Client Strategy
nodes.rationale: Each client's objectives are studied individually; a 15-month plan uses the first 3 months to achieve initial results, which then shape the agenda for the remaining 12 months.

nodes.label: 3-Month Optimization Cadence
nodes.source_location: How do we keep up?! picture
nodes.rationale: Month 1: Audience Optimization, Month 2: Content Optimization, Month 3: Budget Optimization.

nodes.label: Hourly Rate & Industry Exclusivity
nodes.rationale: All solutions are billed at an hourly rate ('you pay for the time we spend giving you our attention') because the company does not work against a client's brand: while partnered with a client in an industry, it will not cooperate with any other client in that same field.

nodes.label: Fixed-Price Products for Startups
nodes.rationale: For medium-sized startups the company offers service products at fixed prices, to develop the digital market and partner with emerging businesses; each product ships with a practical manual for integration with the other services.

nodes.label: 15-Month Strategy & Tactic
nodes.rationale: 15-month plan with the first 3 months producing initial results that set the remaining 12 months' agenda; flexibility comes from a dedicated R&D team per product and continuous competitor monitoring.

nodes.label: Special Exclusive Bundle (Flyer)
nodes.rationale: Bundle spans social media management, visual identity, content production, performance marketing, website & landing pages, and Google services; website, ad spend, and media production are charged extra.

nodes.label: Bundle Pricing Tiers
nodes.rationale: $700/month rack rate, discounted to $550/mo for 3 months ($1650), $450/mo for 6 months ($2400), $350/mo for a year plan ($4200) - longer commitments buy lower monthly rates.

nodes.label: 12-Month Bundle Plan
nodes.rationale: The bundle is a 12-month plan: three months to achieve initial results, then the remaining 9 months' plan is built to accomplish the partnership's big goal.

nodes.label: STAGE (On Stage) Company Profile 2025
nodes.rationale: A Canadian marketing/advertising/PR company profile deck (OCR of a slide deck); its presence in the Fifteen repo's MD/ folder is not explained by CLAUDE.md, which only lists Products Guide, Ultimate Guide, and Bundle Flyer as MD/ sources.

nodes.label: STAGE Service Offering
nodes.rationale: Website & mobile app development, visual identity, professional photography, digital marketing, commercial ads, social media management, paid campaigns, SEO, event/conference organization, offline marketing.

nodes.label: Hosting Deploy on Merge Job
nodes.rationale: Push to main deploys to the live Firebase Hosting channel via FirebaseExtended/action-hosting-deploy.

nodes.label: Hosting Preview Deploy on PR Job
nodes.rationale: Guarded by head.repo.full_name == github.repository so preview deploys only run for same-repo PRs (fork PRs cannot access the FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT secret).
nodes.norm_label: hosting preview deploy on pr job

nodes.label: Firestore & Storage Rules Deploy Job
nodes.rationale: Storage rules deploy is a separate continue-on-error step: the deploy service account may only have Hosting-deploy permissions today (Storage deploy needs the Service Usage API), and a missing Storage permission must not block the more urgent Firestore rules deploy. Fix by granting 'Firebase Rules Admin' + 'Service Usage Consumer' IAM roles.
